content.title: Derby Week Sign Up | Kentucky Derby
content.text: 2026 DERBY WEEK REGISTRATION Sign up to be a part of the online sale for 2026 Derby Week Tickets! Ticketing Days include Opening Night, 502'sDay, Winsday, and Thurby. Derby Week Sign Up Information Derby Week Racing begins Saturday April 25th 2026 and concludes with the 152nd running of the Kentucky Derby. Before the Greatest Two Minutes in Sports®, experience amazing race days at Churchill Downs. Each day the anticipation builds in the lead up to the Kentucky Derby as contenders train, fashion is on display, and the best of Kentucky come together to celebrate the biggest race. Group Sign Up Information If you are interested in bringing your group to Churchill Downs for Derby Week Days then please fill out the below inquiry for Opening Night, Dawn at the Downs, 502'sday, Winsday, and Thurby! DERBY WEEK EVENTS There are plenty of ways to join the thrills of the Derby Week with great race day experiences. Learn about the daily events leading up to the Run for the Roses! OPENING NIGHT Kick-off Derby Week with the most stylish night in horse racing. Preview 2026 Kentucky Derby trends with a fashion show and gain style tips from featured Kentucky Derby Milliners. DAWN AT THE DOWNS Everyone’s favorite behind-the-scenes tradition. Spend your morning at Churchill Downs to watch your favorite Derby and Oaks contenders warm up on the track while listening to expert commentary. 502'sDay 502’sDay celebrates the community, Louisville’s Kentucky Derby tradition makers, inspiration providers and die-hard Derby fans. Winsday Winsday shines a spotlight on Louisville’s robust nonprofit community. THURBY An unforgettable showcase of all things Kentucky, Thurby continues to celebrate Kentucky’s culture: bourbon, Bluegrass and racing!
